title: Unto Jesus Be All Glory
lyrics_original: Let our words and voices soar!
Just to worship at Your feet.
And Your Name to us is sweet.
In Your blood the Gospel's sealed.
You were pierced for our transgressions,
By Your stripes our wounds are healed.
At the cross You did atone
We were rebels, we were debtors,
Now we stand before Your throne.
You surround us with Your favor,
War is raging, but You are reigning,
By Your wise and sovereign hand.
Keep us holy, keep us faithful,
To the Word of Your command.

bible_verses.english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name; that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

devotional.prayer_english: Precious Lord Jesus, unto You alone belongs all glory, honor, and praise. Thank You for Your sacrificial love, for bearing my transgressions, and for sealing my salvation in Your precious blood. My heart longs to sit at Your feet and adore You today. Tune my life to praise Your sweet and worthy name in all that I say and do. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we consider the immense sacrifice of Christ—pierced for our transgressions and sealing our redemption in His precious blood—our hearts naturally overflow with praise. This song invites us to pause, bow at His feet, and lift our voices to the one who is worthy beyond measure. Jesus is not only our Savior who bore our sins, but our exalted Messiah whose name brings sweetness to our souls. Today, let your worship soar as you yield every part of your heart to His loving lordship.
